Result<String> {\n        // Spawn the binary with version command\n        let output = Command::new(binary_path)\n            .args(version_command)\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n            .output()\n            .with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to spawn binary '{}' for version check\",\n                    binary_path.display()\n                )\n            })?;\n\n        // Check exit code\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);\n            bail!(\n                \"binary '{}' exited with status {}: {}\",\n                binary_path.display(),\n                output.status,\n                stderr.trim()\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Parse stdout to extract backend name\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n        let stdout = stdout.trim();\n\n        // Try to match common version output patterns\n        // Expected formats:\n        // - \"bead 0.x.y\" or \"bead 0.x.y (details)\"\n        // - \"bf 0.x.y\" or \"bf 0.x.y (details)\"\n        // - \"beads-rust 0.x.y\"\n\n        // Pattern 1: First word before whitespace (e.g., \"bead\" from \"bead 0.1.3\")\n        let first_word_pattern = Regex::new(r\"^(\\S+)\\s\").unwrap();\n        if let Some(caps) = first_word_pattern.captures(stdout) {\n            if let Some(name) = caps.get(1) {\n                return Ok(name.as_str().to_string());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Pattern 2: If no space, entire output is the name (e.g., just \"bead\")\n        if !stdout.is_empty() && !stdout.contains(char::is_whitespace) {\n            return Ok(stdout.to_string());\n        }\n\n        bail!(\n            \"unable to parse backend name from version output: '{}'\",\n            stdout\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Classify an error using only this backend's declared markers.\n    pub fn error_contains_any(&self, message: &str, markers: &[String]) -> bool {\n        let message = message.to_lowercase();\n        markers\n            .iter()\n            .any(|marker| message.contains(&marker.to_lowercase()))\n    }\n\n    /// Validate everything that could otherwise fail during the first claim.\n    pub fn validate(&self, source: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.name.trim().is_empty() {\n            bail!(\"descriptor {} has an empty backend name\", source.display());\n        }\n        if self.binary.trim().is_empty() {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor {} for backend '{}' has an empty binary\",\n                source.display(),\n                self.name\n            );\n        }\n        if self.identity_pattern.trim().is_empty() {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor {} for backend '{}' is missing identity_pattern\",\n                source.display(),\n                self.name\n            );\n        }\n        Regex::new(&self.identity_pattern).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"descriptor {} for backend '{}' has invalid identity_pattern {:?}\",\n                source.display(),\n                self.name,\n                self.identity_pattern\n            )\n        })?;\n        if self.version_command.is_empty() {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor {} for backend '{}' has an empty version_command\",\n                source.display(),\n                self.name\n            );\n        }\n\n        for required in REQUIRED_OPERATIONS {\n            if !self.operations.contains_key(*required) {\n                bail!(\n                    \"descriptor {} for backend '{}' is missing required operation '{}'\",\n                    source.display(),\n                    self.name,\n                    required\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (operation, spec) in &self.operations {\n            if spec.timeout_secs == Some(0) {\n                bail!(\n                    \"descriptor {} operation '{}' has a zero timeout\",\n                    source.display(),\n                    operation\n                );\n            }\n            if let Some(strategy) = &spec.strategy {\n                validate_strategy_name(source, operation, strategy)?;\n            }\n            validate_placeholders(source, operation, &spec.argv)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_placeholders(source: &Path, operation: &str, argv: &[String]) -> Result<()> {\n    let placeholder = Regex::new(r\"\\{([^{}]+)\\}\").expect(\"static placeholder regex is valid\");\n    let allowed = allowed_placeholders(operation);\n\n    for argument in argv {\n        let mut remainder = argument.clone();\n        for capture in placeholder.captures_iter(argument) {\n            let full = capture.get(0).expect(\"capture zero exists\").as_str();\n            let name = capture.get(1).expect(\"capture one exists\").as_str();\n            if !allowed.contains(&name) {\n                bail!(\n                    \"descriptor {} operation '{}' has unresolvable placeholder '{{{}}}'\",\n                    source.display(),\n                    operation,\n                    name\n                );\n            }\n            remainder = remainder.replacen(full, \"\", 1);\n        }\n        if remainder.contains('{') || remainder.contains('}') {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor {} operation '{}' has malformed placeholder in {:?}\",\n                source.display(),\n                operation,\n                argument\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn allowed_placeholders(operation: descriptors, overriding built-ins by name.\npub fn load_bead_backends(\n    dir: &Path,\n    built_ins: &[BeadBackend],\n) -> Result<HashMap<String, BeadBackend>> {\n    let mut backends = directory: {}\", dir.display()))?\n        .map(|entry| entry.map(|entry| entry.path()))\n        .collect::<std::io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;\n    paths.sort();\n\n    for path in paths {\n        let full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !matches!(self.backend.name.as_str(), \"bead-rs\" | \"bead-forge\") {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor-driven full rebuild is not   \"refusing to rebuild backend '{}' without checkpoint {}\",\n                self.backend.name,\n                checkpoint.display()\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Keep the complete SQLite file set recoverable until import and\n        // doctor verification both succeed. {\n                path.with_extension(format!(\n                    \"{}needle-rebuild-backup\",\n                    path.extension()\n                        .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())\n                        .map(|extension| format!(\"{extension}.\"))\n                        .unwrap_or_default()\n                ))\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"refusing to overwrite prior rebuild backup {}\",\n                    backup.display()\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n            if path.exists() {\n                if let Err(preserve_error) = tokio::fs::rename(path, backup).await {\n                    for (original, preserved) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                        if preserved.exists() {\n                            let _ = tokio::fs::rename(preserved, original).await;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    return Err(preserve_error).with_context(|| {\n                        format!(\n                            \"failed to preserve {} as {}; prior files were restored\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        )\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let rebuild = async {\n            if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.import\",\n                    &[\"sync\".to_string(), \"--import-only\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n            } else {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.init\",\n                    &[\"init\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n                let checkpoint = checkpoint\n                    .to_str()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"checkpoint path is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n                let args = vec![\n                    \"sync\".to_string(),\n                    \"import-only\".to_string(),\n                    \"--input\".to_string(),\n                    checkpoint.to_string(),\n                    \"--restore-into-empty\".to_string(),\n                    \"--actor\".to_string(),\n                    \"needle\".to_string(),\n                ];\n                self.run_argv(\"full_rebuild.import\", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS)\n                    .await?;\n            }\n            let report = self.doctor_check().await?;\n            if !report.warnings.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"database still has issues after rebuild: {:?}\",\n                    report.warnings\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        .await;\n\n        if let Err(rebuild_error) = rebuild {\n            let mut rollback_errors = Vec::new();\n            for path in &db_paths {\n                if path.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::remove_file(path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to remove incomplete rebuild {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                if backup.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::rename(backup, path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to restore {} from {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if !rollback_errors.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"rebuild failed ({rebuild_error:#}); rollback was incomplete: {}\",\n                    rollback_errors.join(\"; \")\n                );\n            }\n            return Err(rebuild_error.context(\"rebuild failed; original database restored\"));\n        }\n\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                tokio::fs::remove_file(backup).await.with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"rebuild succeeded but failed to remove {}\",\n                        backup.display()\n async fn doctor_repair(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {\n        let stdout = self.run_operation(\"doctor_repair\", &HashMap::new()).await?;\n        Ok(parse_doctor_output(&stdout))\n    }\n    async fn doctor_check(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {\n        let stdout = self.run_operation(\"doctor_check\", &HashMap::new()).await?;\n        Ok(parse_doctor_output(&stdout))\n    }\n    async fn full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !matches!(self.backend.name.as_str(), \"bead-rs\" | \"bead-forge\") {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor-driven full rebuild is not enabled for backend '{}'\",\n                self.backend.name\n            );\n        }\n\n        let checkpoint = if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/issues.jsonl\")\n        } else {\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/checkpoint\")\n        };\n        if !checkpoint.exists() {\n            bail!(\n                \"refusing to rebuild backend '{}' without checkpoint {}\",\n                self.backend.name,\n                checkpoint.display()\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Keep the complete SQLite file set recoverable until import and\n        // doctor verification both succeed. A failed import must never turn a\n        // repairable store into an empty or partially initialized one.\n        let db_paths = [\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db\"),\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db-wal\"),\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db-shm\"),\n        ];\n        let backup_paths = db_paths\n            .iter()\n            .map(|path| {\n                path.with_extension(format!(\n                    \"{}needle-rebuild-backup\",\n                    path.extension()\n                        .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())\n                        .map(|extension| format!(\"{extension}.\"))\n                        .unwrap_or_default()\n                ))\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"refusing to overwrite prior rebuild backup {}\",\n                    backup.display()\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n            if path.exists() {\n                if let Err(preserve_error) = tokio::fs::rename(path, backup).await {\n                    for (original, preserved) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                        if preserved.exists() {\n                            let _ = tokio::fs::rename(preserved, original).await;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    return Err(preserve_error).with_context(|| {\n                        format!(\n                            \"failed to preserve {} as {}; prior files were restored\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        )\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let rebuild = async {\n            if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.import\",\n                    &[\"sync\".to_string(), \"--import-only\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n            } else {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.init\",\n                    &[\"init\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n                let checkpoint = checkpoint\n                    .to_str()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"checkpoint path is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n                let args = vec![\n                    \"sync\".to_string(),\n                    \"import-only\".to_string(),\n                    \"--input\".to_string(),\n                    checkpoint.to_string(),\n                    \"--restore-into-empty\".to_string(),\n                    \"--actor\".to_string(),\n                    \"needle\".to_string(),\n                ];\n                self.run_argv(\"full_rebuild.import\", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS)\n                    .await?;\n            }\n            let report = self.doctor_check().await?;\n            if !report.warnings.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"database still has issues after rebuild: {:?}\",\n                    report.warnings\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        .await;\n\n        if let Err(rebuild_error) = rebuild {\n            let mut rollback_errors = Vec::new();\n            for path in &db_paths {\n                if path.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::remove_file(path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to remove incomplete rebuild {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                if backup.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::rename(backup, path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to restore {} from {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if !rollback_errors.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"rebuild failed ({rebuild_error:#}); rollback was incomplete: {}\",\n                    rollback_errors.join(\"; \")\n                );\n            }\n            return Err(rebuild_error.context(\"rebuild failed; original database restored\"));\n        }\n\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                tokio::fs::remove_file(backup).await.with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"rebuild succeeded but failed to remove {}\",\n                        backup.display()\n                    )\n                })?;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn has_valid_store(&self) -> bool {\n        self.workspace.join(\".beads\").is_dir()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl CliBeadStore {\n    async fn claim_via_batch(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n        let shown = self.show(id).await?;\n        if shown.status != BeadStatus::Open {\n            return Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {\n                reason: format!(\"bead is {}, not open\", shown.status),\n            });\n        }\n        if let Some(claimed_by) = shown.assignee {\n            return Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by });\n        }\n\n        // bf 0.4.1 removed --assignee from `update`, but its transactional\n        // batch update operation still accepts Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost {\n                claimed_by: claimed.assignee.unwrap_or_else(|| \"(unknown)\".to_string()),\n            })\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn run_bf_update_batch(\n        &self,\n        id: &BeadId,\n        status: Option<&str>,\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut operation = serde_json::Map::new();\n   }\n    Ok(names)\n}\n\nfn parse_beads(shape: ParseShape, output: &str) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {\n    if output.trim().is_empty() {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n    match shape {\n        ParseShape::JsonArray => serde_json::from_str(output).context(\"invalid JSON array\"),\n        ParseShape::JsonObject => {\n            if let Ok(bead) = serde_json::from_str::<Bead>(output) {\n                return Ok(vec![bead]);\n            }\n            let beads: Vec<Bead> = serde_json::from_str(output).context(\"invalid JSON object\")?;\n            if beads.len() != 1 {\n                bail!(\"expected one JSON object, found {}\", beads.len());\n            }\n            Ok(beads)\n        }\n        ParseShape::JsonLines => {\n            // bead-rs emits a JSON array (`[]`) for an empty result set but\n            // newline-delimited objects otherwise. let mut beads = Vec::new();\n            for line in output.lines() {\n                let line = line.trim();\n                if line.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if line.starts_with('[') {\n                    let batch: Vec<Bead> =\n                        serde_json::from_str(line).context(\"invalid JSON array line\")?;\n                    beads.extend(batch);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                beads.push(serde_json::from_str(line).context(\"invalid JSON line\")?);\n            }\n            Ok(beads)\n        }\n        ParseShape::BareId | ParseShape::None => {\n            bail!(\"parse shape {shape:?} cannot produce bead records\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize)]\nstruct BeadWithClaimHistory {\n    #[serde(flatten)]\n    bead: Bead,\n    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = \"count_claim_events\")]\n    events: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize)]\nstruct D::Error>\nwhere\n    D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,\n{\n    struct ClaimEventVisitor;\n\n    impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for ClaimEventVisitor {\n        type Value = Option<u32>;\n\n        fn Result<Self::Value, A::Error>\n        where\n            A: SeqAccess<'de>,\n        {\n            let mut count = 0u32;\n            while let Some(event) = sequence.next_element::<EventTypeOnly>()? {\n                if matches!(\n                    event.event_type.as_deref(),\n                    Some(\"claimed\") | Some(\"assignee_changed\") | Some(\"claim\")\n                ) {\n                    count = count.saturating_add(1);\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(Some(count))\n        }\n\n        fn visit_none<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E>\n        where\n            E: de::Error,\n        {\n            Ok(Some(0))\n        }\n\n        fn visit_unit<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E>\n        where\n            E: de::Error,\n        {\n            Ok(Some(0))\n        }\n    }\n\n    deserializer.deserialize_any(ClaimEventVisitor)\n}\n\nfn parse_beads_with_claim_history(\n    shape: ParseShape,\n    output: &str,\n) -> Result<Vec<(Bead, Option<u32>)>> {\n    if output.trim().is_empty() {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let records = match shape {\n        ParseShape::JsonArray => serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BeadWithClaimHistory>>(output)?,\n        ParseShape::JsonObject => {\n            if let Ok(record) = serde_json::from_str::<BeadWithClaimHistory>(output) {\n           records.extend(serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BeadWithClaimHistory>>(line)?);\n                    continue;\n                }\n async fn doctor_repair(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {\n        let stdout = self.run_operation(\"doctor_repair\", &HashMap::new()).await?;\n        Ok(parse_doctor_output(&stdout))\n    }\n    async fn doctor_check(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {\n        let stdout = self.run_operation(\"doctor_check\", &HashMap::new()).await?;\n        Ok(parse_doctor_output(&stdout))\n    }\n    async fn full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !matches!(self.backend.name.as_str(), \"bead-rs\" | \"bead-forge\") {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor-driven full rebuild is not enabled for backend '{}'\",\n                self.backend.name\n            );\n        }\n\n        let checkpoint = if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/issues.jsonl\")\n        } else {\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/checkpoint\")\n        };\n        if !checkpoint.exists() {\n            bail!(\n                \"refusing to rebuild backend '{}' without checkpoint {}\",\n                self.backend.name,\n                checkpoint.display()\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Keep the complete SQLite file set recoverable until import and\n        // doctor verification both succeed. A failed import must never turn a\n        // repairable store into an empty or partially initialized one.\n        let db_paths = [\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db\"),\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db-wal\"),\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db-shm\"),\n        ];\n        let backup_paths = db_paths\n            .iter()\n            .map(|path| {\n                path.with_extension(format!(\n                    \"{}needle-rebuild-backup\",\n                    path.extension()\n                        .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())\n                        .map(|extension| format!(\"{extension}.\"))\n                        .unwrap_or_default()\n                ))\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"refusing to overwrite prior rebuild backup {}\",\n                    backup.display()\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n            if path.exists() {\n                if let Err(preserve_error) = tokio::fs::rename(path, backup).await {\n                    for (original, preserved) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                        if preserved.exists() {\n                            let _ = tokio::fs::rename(preserved, original).await;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    return Err(preserve_error).with_context(|| {\n                        format!(\n                            \"failed to preserve {} as {}; prior files were restored\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        )\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let rebuild = async {\n            if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.import\",\n                    &[\"sync\".to_string(), \"--import-only\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n            } else {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.init\",\n                    &[\"init\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n                let checkpoint = checkpoint\n                    .to_str()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"checkpoint path is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n                let args = vec![\n                    \"sync\".to_string(),\n                    \"import-only\".to_string(),\n                    \"--input\".to_string(),\n                    checkpoint.to_string(),\n                    \"--restore-into-empty\".to_string(),\n                    \"--actor\".to_string(),\n                    \"needle\".to_string(),\n                ];\n                self.run_argv(\"full_rebuild.import\", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS)\n                    .await?;\n            }\n            let report = self.doctor_check().await?;\n            if !report.warnings.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"database still has issues after rebuild: {:?}\",\n                    report.warnings\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        .await;\n\n        if let Err(rebuild_error) = rebuild {\n            let mut rollback_errors = Vec::new();\n            for path in &db_paths {\n                if path.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::remove_file(path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to remove incomplete rebuild {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                if backup.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::rename(backup, path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to restore {} from {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if !rollback_errors.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"rebuild failed ({rebuild_error:#}); rollback was incomplete: {}\",\n                    rollback_errors.join(\"; \")\n                );\n            }\n            return Err(rebuild_error.context(\"rebuild failed; original database restored\"));\n        }\n\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                tokio::fs::remove_file(backup).await.with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"rebuild succeeded but failed to remove {}\",\n                        backup.display()\n                    )\n                })?;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn has_valid_store(&self) -> bool {\n        self.workspace.join(\".beads\").is_dir()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl CliBeadStore {\n    async fn claim_via_batch(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n        let shown = self.show(id).await?;\n        if shown.status != BeadStatus::Open {\n            return Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {\n                reason: format!(\"bead is {}, not open\", shown.status),\n            });\n        }\n        if let Some(claimed_by) = shown.assignee {\n            return Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by });\n        }\n\n        // bf 0.4.1 removed --assignee from `update`, but its transactional\n        // batch update operation still accepts Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost {\n                claimed_by: claimed.assignee.unwrap_or_else(|| \"(unknown)\".to_string()),\n            })\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn run_bf_update_batch(\n        &self,\n        id: &BeadId,\n        status: Option<&str>,\n        assignee: Option<&str>,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut operation = serde_json::Map::new();\n match shape {\n        ParseShape::JsonArray => serde_json::from_str(output).context(\"invalid JSON array\"),\n        ParseShape::JsonObject => {\n            if let Ok(bead) = serde_json::from_str::<Bead>(output) {\n                return Ok(vec![bead]);\n            }\n            let beads: Vec<Bead> = serde_json::from_str(output).context(\"invalid JSON object\")?;\n            if beads.len() != 1 {\n                bail!(\"expected one JSON object, found {}\", beads.len());\n            }\n            Ok(beads)\n        }\n        ParseShape::JsonLines => {\n            // bead-rs emits a JSON array (`[]`) for an empty result set but\n            // newline-delimited objects otherwise. let mut beads = Vec::new();\n            for line in output.lines() {\n                let line = line.trim();\n                if line.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n beads.extend(batch);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                beads.push(serde_json::from_str(line).context(\"invalid JSON line\")?);\n            }\n            Ok(beads)\n        }\n        ParseShape::BareId | ParseShape::None => {\n            bail!(\"parse shape {shape:?} cannot produce bead records\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize)]\nstruct BeadWithClaimHistory {\n    #[serde(flatten)]\n    bead: Bead,\n    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = \"count_claim_events\")]\n    events: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize)]\nstruct D::Error>\nwhere\n    D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,\n{\n    struct ClaimEventVisitor;\n\n    impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for ClaimEventVisitor {\n        type Value = Option<u32>;\n\n        fn Result<Self::Value, A::Error>\n        where\n            A: SeqAccess<'de>,\n        {\n            let mut count = 0u32;\n            while let Some(event) = sequence.next_element::<EventTypeOnly>()? {\n                if matches!(\n                    event.event_type.as_deref(),\n                    Some(\"claimed\") | Some(\"assignee_changed\") | Some(\"claim\")\n                ) {\n                    count = count.saturating_add(1);\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(Some(count))\n        }\n\n        fn visit_none<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E>\n        where\n            E: de::Error,\n        {\n            Ok(Some(0))\n        }\n\n        fn visit_unit<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E>\n        where\n            E: de::Error,\n        {\n            Ok(Some(0))\n        }\n    }\n\n    deserializer.deserialize_any(ClaimEventVisitor)\n}\n\nfn parse_beads_with_claim_history(\n    shape: ParseShape,\n    output: &str,\n) -> Result<Vec<(Bead, Option<u32>)>> {\n    if output.trim().is_empty() {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let records = match shape {\n        ParseShape::JsonArray => serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BeadWithClaimHistory>>(output)?,\n        ParseShape::JsonObject => {\n            if let Ok(record) = serde_json::from_str::<BeadWithClaimHistory>(output) {\n           records.extend(serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BeadWithClaimHistory>>(line)?);\n                    continue;\n                }\n full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !matches!(self.backend.name.as_str(), \"bead-rs\" | \"bead-forge\") {\n            bail!(\n                \"descriptor-driven full rebuild is not self.workspace.join(\".beads/issues.jsonl\")\n        } else {\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/checkpoint\")\n        };\n        if !checkpoint.exists() {\n            bail!(\n                \"refusing to rebuild backend '{}' without checkpoint {}\",\n                self.backend.name,\n                checkpoint.display()\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Keep the complete SQLite file set recoverable until import and\n        // doctor verification both succeed. A failed import must never turn a\n        // repairable store into an empty or partially initialized one.\n        let db_paths = [\n            self.workspace.join(\".beads/beads.db\"),\n {\n                path.with_extension(format!(\n                    \"{}needle-rebuild-backup\",\n                    path.extension()\n                        .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())\n                        .map(|extension| format!(\"{extension}.\"))\n                        .unwrap_or_default()\n                ))\n            })\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"refusing to overwrite prior rebuild backup {}\",\n                    backup.display()\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n            if path.exists() {\n                if let Err(preserve_error) = tokio::fs::rename(path, backup).await {\n                    for (original, preserved) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                        if preserved.exists() {\n                            let _ = tokio::fs::rename(preserved, original).await;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    return Err(preserve_error).with_context(|| {\n                        format!(\n                            \"failed to preserve {} as {}; prior files were restored\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        )\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let rebuild = async {\n            if self.backend.name == \"bead-forge\" {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.import\",\n                    &[\"sync\".to_string(), \"--import-only\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n            } else {\n                self.run_argv(\n                    \"full_rebuild.init\",\n                    &[\"init\".to_string()],\n                    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n                )\n                .await?;\n                let checkpoint = checkpoint\n                    .to_str()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"checkpoint path is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n                let args = vec![\n                    \"sync\".to_string(),\n                    \"import-only\".to_string(),\n                    \"--input\".to_string(),\n                    checkpoint.to_string(),\n                    \"--restore-into-empty\".to_string(),\n                    \"--actor\".to_string(),\n                    \"needle\".to_string(),\n                ];\n                self.run_argv(\"full_rebuild.import\", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS)\n                    .await?;\n            }\n            let report = self.doctor_check().await?;\n            if !report.warnings.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"database still has issues after rebuild: {:?}\",\n                    report.warnings\n                );\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        .await;\n\n        if let Err(rebuild_error) = rebuild {\n            let mut rollback_errors = Vec::new();\n            for path in &db_paths {\n                if path.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::remove_file(path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to remove incomplete rebuild {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {\n                if backup.exists() {\n                    if let Err(error) = tokio::fs::rename(backup, path).await {\n                        rollback_errors.push(format!(\n                            \"failed to restore {} from {}: {error}\",\n                            path.display(),\n                            backup.display()\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if !rollback_errors.is_empty() {\n                bail!(\n                    \"rebuild failed ({rebuild_error:#}); rollback was incomplete: {}\",\n                    rollback_errors.join(\"; \")\n                );\n            }\n            return Err(rebuild_error.context(\"rebuild failed; original database restored\"));\n        }\n\n        for backup in &backup_paths {\n            if backup.exists() {\n                tokio::fs::remove_file(backup).await.with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"rebuild succeeded but failed to remove {}\",\n                        backup.display()\n
